About Me

18 Years of This Work. Still Just Me.

No crews, no office, no runaround. When you hire me, you get me — from the first call to the final cleanup.

👷

Your photo
goes here

I got into this work in 2006 after spending years on construction crews — framing, tile, rough plumbing, all of it. I liked the work but didn't love the scale. Big builds are about speed; what I wanted was to do smaller jobs well.

Handyman work turned out to be the right fit. Homeowners have real problems — a door that won't close right, a bathroom faucet that's dripped for two years, drywall damage from a doorknob that needs to be patched before the painter comes. These things matter. I like fixing them.

Over the years I've built most of my business from referrals. A neighbor tells a neighbor. That's how it works when you do honest work at a fair price and don't disappear after the job is done.

I'm not the cheapest guy in town. But I'm also not the guy who gives you a low quote and pads the invoice at the end. You'll know the price before I start. If something changes, you'll hear from me before I go further.
